panels.title: Experimental cross-node workload mTLS — security gate remains open

options.content:
## Two nodes · no application sidecars · node-level ztunnel
**Positive path:** client on `cmtc-mtls-worker` → server on `cmtc-mtls-control-plane`, via Service and Pod IP.

**Historical baseline:** an unenrolled client reached port 80 before authenticated-only enforcement was installed. Current multiport/restart trials pass; see the [authenticated-only live view](/d/cmtc-authenticated-only). Full fail-closed admission remains open in [issue #8](https://github.com/ephico2real2/clustermesh-trust-controller/issues/8).

**Counter semantics:** non-mTLS TCP opens count attempts before authorization, including connections subsequently rejected. They do not count accepted plaintext HTTP requests.

panels.description: Experimental scope, demonstrated paths and explicit remaining security gates.

panels.description: Destination-reported TCP opens after peer TLS authentication, with connection_security_policy=mutual_tls. Counter increase over the selected time range, handling resets and extrapolated by Prometheus. Not HTTP requests, successful application responses, or TLS handshakes; authenticated connections can still be denied by authorization policy.

panels.title: Connections rejected by policy — DENY

targets.expr: (sum(increase(istio_tcp_connections_failed_total{job="cmtc-spire-ztunnel",cluster="cmtc-mtls",reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace="mtls-spike",response_flags="DENY"}[${__range_ms}ms] @ end())) or on() (0 * sum(increase(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{job="cmtc-spire-ztunnel",cluster="cmtc-mtls",reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace="mtls-spike"}[${__range_ms}ms] @ end())))) and on() (sum(up{job="cmtc-spire-ztunnel",cluster="cmtc-mtls"} @ end()) == 2)

panels.description: Actual destination-reported native failed TCP counter with response_flags=DENY, regardless of authentication state. These rejections overlap the attempted connection counters; never add this stat to TCP attempts to form a total. Counter increase over the selected time range, handling resets and extrapolated by Prometheus.

panels.description: Percent of destination-reported completed TCP attempts in the selected time range, using increase(istio_tcp_connections_closed_total). Each connection belongs to exactly one category; source reports are excluded to prevent double counting. No failure flag does not prove HTTP success. Excludes in-flight connections and early failures without a completed TCP record. These are TCP connections, not HTTP requests or TLS handshakes. Counter increases handle resets and are extrapolated estimates. Zero categories require observed closed-counter telemetry and both node scrapes UP; missing telemetry remains unavailable. Headline totals use this selected range but count TCP opens or failures; the pie counts completed records. They can differ for in-flight connections.

panels.title: Scope and independent evidence

options.content:
**Verified identities:** `spiffe://cmtc-mtls.test/ns/mtls-spike/sa/client` → `…/sa/server`. Workloads have one application container; ztunnel runs per node. Public SVID chains and packet/TLS/canary checks are independent evidence.

**Native table:** lifetime TCP counters, not selected-range totals. A connection reported at each end must not be counted twice. This isolated spike does not qualify ClusterMesh, WireGuard/IPsec composition or complete Protected status. [Current trial](/d/cmtc-authenticated-only).

panels.description: Independent HTTP, identity, packet and retry checks supplement TCP metrics; links retain the remaining acceptance gates.

panels.title: How to read the connection totals and percentages
panels.description: Visible counter and percentage definitions; exact source and remaining security gates are below.

options.content:
**Selected range:** the three totals are counter increases, estimated across resets. Attempts without verified mTLS **include later DENY rejections**; never add DENY to attempts.

**Pie:** one destination record per **completed TCP attempt** in this range; five exclusive outcomes total 100%. In-flight connections and early unrecorded failures are excluded. No failure flag does not prove HTTP success. **TCP connections ≠ HTTP requests ≠ TLS handshakes.**

panels.description: TCP opens per second, rate over $__rate_interval, separately reported by the source and destination node. The two reports describe the same connections; do not add them. Solid blue is the receiving node, dashed red is the source. Missing data is unavailable; these are not TLS handshake counts.

panels.title: Observed peer identities and security policy · native ztunnel counters
panels.description: Last native TCP counter readings at the selected range end, split by node, reporter, verified principals and security. These are lifetime counters and can reset. Source and destination rows overlap; do not sum them. DENY means policy rejection, and a dash means no failure flag, not proven HTTP success.
